{{Quote|Nem'ro's engineering corps works long hours. Many days. Finds way to introduce random variances in hated Fa'athra's automated factories.|[[Rudd (Ugnaught)|Rudd]]|<ref name="TOR" />}}
An '''engineering corps''' was affiliated with the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Suudaa Nem'ro|Nem'ro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During a gang war between [[Nem'ro's gang]] and the rival [[Fa'athra gang]], the engineering corps worked many [[Standard day/Legends|days]] to find a way to sabotage [[Voontara Fa'athra|Fa'athra's]] factories.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nem'ro's engineering corps was first mentioned in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
